verdict.rationale: There is no evidence of a downloadable OpenAPI or Swagger spec: every common candidate path (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) returned 404. The closest substitutes are an llms.txt index and API reference pages served as markdown, such as the posts resource page. These are agent-readable but not a structured, machine-parseable API spec. missing for 10: a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent schema file, documentation pointing to where such a spec can be downloaded, any independent confirmation that a spec exists.
